说明: English translation of the Aoid interface.

词典.用 USB 线连接手机: Connect your phone with a USB cable
词典.在手机上打开「开发者选项 → USB 调试」，插线后点「允许」。左侧会立刻出现这: On your phone, open Developer options → USB debugging, plug in the cable, then tap "Allow". The device will appear on the left.
词典.不同品牌怎么打开 USB 调试？: How do I enable USB debugging on my brand?
词典.Aoid 需要一个 adb（约 8MB）才能与手机通信。: Aoid needs adb (about 8 MB) to talk to your phone.
词典.快捷键只在窗口获得焦点时生效，会覆盖原本的按键操作。: Shortcuts only work while the window is focused, and override the original key binding.
词典.直接投递到手机当前聚焦的输入框；没有输入框时会自动复制到剪贴板。: Sends text to the focused input on your phone; if there is none, the text is copied to the clipboard.
词典.回车发送到手机输入框: Press Enter to send to your phone
词典.把手机当作电脑的摄像头和麦克风。: Use your phone as a webcam and microphone.
词典.开启后手机自动静音: Your phone is muted while this is on
词典.手机复制内容时同步到电脑，反之亦然: Sync clipboard between your phone and this PC
词典.每个操作可以绑定多个触发方式。点击「添加」后，直接按下想用的键或用鼠标点一下。: Each action can have several triggers. Click "Add", then press the key or mouse button you want.
词典.绑定生效时会覆盖该位置原本的按键操作，且只在 Aoid 窗口获得焦点时起作用。: Bindings override the original key, and only work while the Aoid window is focused.
词典.请按下要绑定的键，或点击鼠标按键…: Press a key or click a mouse button…
词典.Aoid 只在你的电脑上运行，不连接任何服务器，也不收集任何数据。: Aoid runs entirely on your computer. It connects to no server and collects no data.
词典.所有数据都保存在本机，删掉应用即彻底清除。: Everything is stored locally; removing the app deletes it all.
词典.基于 scrcpy 服务端的电脑控制手机工具。画面与触控走 USB，不收集数据、: A Windows tool to control your phone, powered by scrcpy. Video and touch go over USB; no data is collected and nothing needs to be installed on the phone.
词典.在手机上打开「设置 → 关于手机」，连点「版本号」7 次开启开发者选项: On your phone, open Settings → About phone and tap "Build number" 7 times to enable Developer options
词典.进入「开发者选项」，打开「USB 调试」: Open Developer options and turn on "USB debugging"
词典.用数据线连接电脑，手机上弹出授权窗口时点「允许」: Connect the USB cable and tap "Allow" when the authorization dialog appears
词典.插上数据线后，设备会自动出现在左侧列表: Once the cable is plugged in, the device appears in the list on the left
词典.方式一：配对码配对（Android 11 及以上的「无线调试」）: Option 1: pair with a code (Wireless debugging, Android 11+)
词典.方式二：直接连接已配对设备: Option 2: connect to an already-paired device
词典.把当前 USB 设备转为无线: Switch this USB device to wireless
词典.绝大多数安卓手机开 USB 调试都是同一条路，只有「版本号」的位置因品牌而异。: Enabling USB debugging is the same on almost every Android phone; only the location of "Build number" differs by brand.
词典.进入「设置 → 关于手机」，连续点击: Open Settings → About phone and tap
词典.7 次，直到提示「您已处于开发者模式」。: 7 times until you see "You are now a developer".
词典.版本号在各家系统里的位置（设置 → 关于手机 之下）：: Where to find "Build number" (under Settings → About phone):
词典.：全部参数与信息 → MIUI 版本（澎湃 OS 为「OS 版本」）: : All specs → MIUI version (OS version on HyperOS)
词典.：关于手机 → 软件信息 → 版本号: : About phone → Software information → Build number
词典.回到「设置 → 系统 → 开发者选项」（部分机型在「设置 → 更多设置」里），: Go to Settings → System → Developer options (some phones: Settings → More settings), find
词典.Android 8 及更早版本在「设置 → 开发者选项」；Android 9 及: On Android 8 and older it is under Settings → Developer options; on Android 9+ it lives under System.
词典.用数据线连接电脑，手机会弹出「允许 USB 调试吗」，勾选「一律允许」后点确定。: Connect the USB cable. When your phone asks "Allow USB debugging?", check "Always allow" and tap OK.
词典.如果没弹窗，拔插一次数据线，或换一根: If nothing pops up, unplug and replug, or use a cable that
词典.：版本号没点够，再多点几次；个别定制系统要先登录账号。: : You did not tap Build number enough times. Some ROMs require signing in first.
词典.：在手机上重新确认授权，或到开发者选项里点「撤销 USB 调试授权」再插一次。: : Re-confirm the prompt, or revoke USB debugging authorizations and replug.
词典.：下拉通知栏，把 USB 用途从「仅充电」改成「传输文件」。: : Pull down the notification shade and switch USB usage from "Charging only" to "File transfer".
词典.：需要在开发者选项里同时打开「仅充电模式下允许 ADB 调试」。: : You must also enable "USB debugging (Security settings)" in Developer options.
词典.：部分机型要求先登录厂商账号才能开启。: : Some models require signing in to the vendor account first.
词典.：可能被管理策略禁用，无法自行开启。: : It may be disabled by policy and cannot be enabled.

词典.），品牌差异部分按各家系统整理。: ); brand differences are organized from each vendor’s system.
词典.Aoid 支持加载第三方语言包。把一个 JSON 文件放进下面的文件夹，重启后在: Aoid can load third-party language packs. Drop a JSON file into the folder below, restart, then pick it from the language list.
词典.语言包格式：顶层是「中文原文 → 译文」的对照表，可参考内置的 zh-CN.js: Format: a flat map of "original Chinese → translation". See the bundled zh-CN.json for reference.
